quest.title: An Artist Adrift
quest.description: You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x15000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like this guy's not doing so good... He must be famished! Let's give him some of our food, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: May this food give him strength.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not to be biased or anything, but Paimon thinks you make great food!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You give the collapsed man some Teyvat Fried Egg.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I... I live! I live again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, he must really have been starving. That was just one fried egg...

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Ah, that unspeakable deliciousness was enough to revive the dead, surely! If I had known that fried eggs could taste this glorious, I would've bought that mysterious egg off that fellow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What mysterious egg?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: It is said that eating the egg can help you deflect a day's worth of misfortune. Oh, how I wish I'd bought one... or perhaps even twelve...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that sounds really suspicious — and Paimon reckons she knows a scam when she sees one. Still, how did you end up here?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I... Well, I'm a renowned artist from Fontaine, and I'm here in Sumeru to gather inspiration for my work. Call me Julien.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Aren't there more suitable places for gathering inspiration? Y'know, someplace with a better view and better safety measures?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, if you're an artist from Fontaine, why are you empty-handed? ... You're actually a Fatui mole, aren't you?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Such radical reasoning! So radical, in fact, that one wonders what experiences may have led you to even have such thoughts! However, I am an artist, and nothing but that, I fear.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: It's just that... Well, I had already gained enough inspiration here and was preparing to return to Fontaine with what I'd gained.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I never expected that Sumeru's weather could be so dry. When I passed through Chenyu Vale on my way here, the air still felt relatively humid, but the sandstorms started picking up the moment I stepped into Sumeru's bounds...

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: I must confess that I'm better suited to wetter climates, so I was planning to travel back by water to experience different scenery, but my raft was washed away, and I'm not a swimmer, so...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I imagine you must have had a hard time living in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: That is the case, though it is not merely a matter of being a swimmer or not... *sigh* Never mind. I did find a place to rest by the water and there are still some tea leaves that have yet to become completely sodden. Allow me to thank you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By inviting us to have some tea?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Oh, of course, of course! I shall have to express my gratitude for the gift of the fried egg, indeed. How should I address the two of you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right, Paimon almost forgot about introductions!

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Ah, such brilliant names. Well, whatever the case, come and have some tea. My camp is nearby. In fact, we're almost there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We're {NICKNAME} and Paimon — the awesomest companion!

choices.text: Call us Shining Gold and Silver Glimmer.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We're the Shining Gold {NICKNAME}, and the Silver Glimmering Paimon!

choices.text: Does anyone even call themselves a "renowned" anything?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon! Everyone's definitely fainted from hunger at least once in their lives, right?

talks.objective: Return with Julien to his camp

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a simple camp... Paimon wonders if you could even call it a camp.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Well, the scenery here is quite good, and there's a sense of openness whenever I stand by the water. It's honestly a lot more relaxing than when I was in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What sort of life did you lead while you were there, seriously? That's... not quite what Paimon was expecting from a renowned artist.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I lived in a very small place back in Fontaine... And um, that's only because I'm a humble person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But even outdoor adventurer camps look way better than this. Huh? You have an animal buddy?

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Um, I don't have one. This must've been left behind by an adventurer or something like that. Speaking of which...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I would love to receive you in better fashion, but most of my luggage fell into the water when my raft fell apart, and I cannot swim...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: But if you could find my lost luggage for me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would it even be usable after getting soaked like that...

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I did carefully pack everything up, but there are some things that... *sigh* Well, if I've lost them, I've lost them. I can always redraw them... yes, redraw them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, perhaps we should help out. This guy seems like he's in a real bad spot.

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: I have no one else to rely on here, so I can only ask the two of you for aid. I'll be waiting here with some good tea in hand.

talks.objective: Look for Julien's luggage in the water
Look for Julien's luggage in the water
Look for Julien's luggage on the beach
Check on the dog on the beach

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Strange. Why would there be a dog here? And it seems to be guarding something, too.

dialogues.speaker: Dog
dialogues.text: (Watches you warily.)

response.speaker: Dog
response.text: (Gives a short bark.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, didn't we see a food bowl back at Julien's camp? Maybe it belongs to this fella! Strange, though. Didn't Julien say that he didn't have any animal companions?

response.speaker: Dog
response.text: *whimpers*

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The dog runs toward the camp...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's gone... Let's ask Julien about this later. For now, though... Paimon wonders what's under this sand pile. Should we take a look?

choices.text: Where did this wild dog come from, anyway...

response.speaker: Dog
response.text: (Gives a low growl.)

talks.objective: Go to the camp and talk to Julien

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Huh, so it is your animal companion, Julien!

dialogues.speaker: Dog
dialogues.text: (Lets out a threatening growl.)

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Wonderful, Pepper... Taken to growling at me, have you? Don't you know who's keeping us both fed here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Oh, so it has a name! But on the other hand... is this guy seriously arguing with a dog?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Is that what "close" looks like to you!?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Julien! We found the stuff you lost! Pepper's your animal buddy, isn't it? Why did you lie to us earlier?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: If this ungrateful fellow counts as my buddy... I'd rather adopt a Rifthound.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I doubt that you'll be companions for very long...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly. If someone like you, who faints from hunger, ran into a Rifthound, the resulting problem wouldn't be one we could solve with just a Teyvat Fried Egg...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, it seems to have been guarding a drawing board on the beach.

choices.text: It might have wanted to hide it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bad doggie!

response.speaker: Pepper
response.text: (Barks, seemingly in protest.)

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Are you seriously whining about this? If I hadn't followed you into this corner, I could've returned to Fontaine via my original path...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Didn't you say that you ended up taking the waterways because you wanted to see the sights there?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Okay, fine... The truth is, I didn't even get to enjoy Sumeru's scenery — I just followed the dog and ended up in this place. The roads here point in all directions, so it was impossible to not get lost...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's how it was. C'mon, you should have just told us the truth from the start! Why didn't you?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Um... To... preserve the image of a renowned artist?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, you sound like you're just trying to fake us out when you stammer like that, and you're not very good at it either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But speaking of scenery here in Sumeru, {NICKNAME} and Paimon do happen to know some good spots. We can take you there.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: N—No need. Um, I mean... thanks for your offer, but I am a renowned artist, after all. Ultimately, I believe that worthwhile sceneries must be ones that we discover ourselves...

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Oh, and the tea's ready. Do you also happen to have more fried eggs? You know, as a little snack to go with the tea...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Exactly! {NICKNAME}'s a master of many dishes! We can always have something else instead, hehe.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You enjoy the tea together with some snacks.\nThe tea's taste is hard to describe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, this tea...

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: A friend of mine sold it to me. Apparently, it can activate the potential wisdom within you. I think it tastes great.

choices.text: I'm glad I don't have any friends like that.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: How come? Having friends is a good thing. In fact, I came to Sumeru on a friend's recommendation as well.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Thank you both for what you've done for me today. I hope the compensation I prepared meets your expectations...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine, it's just... You sure you don't need our help in gathering inspiration? Paimon feels like you might get lost.

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: The point of a pilgrimage... I mean, the point of a journey lies in walking it by oneself. I shouldn't trouble you two any further. I will undertake this myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, sure, if you say so. Make sure you don't faint from hunger on the road again!

choices.text: Could you give me another cup?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You sure there's nothing wrong with your taste buds, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Julien
response.text: Haha, not to be stingy or anything, but I'll still be in Sumeru for a while, so I need to save some for myself.

choices.text: That sounds like wishful thinking to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... But tea alone feels like it's missing something, you know? Let's just whip something up.

choices.text: It might have been protecting the drawing board from being stolen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it ran off the moment we found it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Is he just usually like that? Seems like a rather troublesome guy...)

dialogues.speaker: Julien
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, what brings the two of you here? You're not here for the same reasons as me... right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean, did we travel here just to make some art? Nah, of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}'s a registered adventurer. It should be no surprise finding {M#him}{F#her} in every corner of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a drawing board! That's gotta be Julien's. Let's haul it back together with the rest. The tea's probably ready by now, so we've gotta hurry!
